import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterPathClean
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePrefix250

/-!
Whole-tape frame adapters for the exact shared-carry prefix250 machine.

Adapted from Permutation252Simulation and the attributed Mira-Cult, Jeff,
and Wade framework at upstream 297ab8df7e5de329605c3875b4934643b371a5e3.
The generic physical-register layout and dispatch frame are retained.

The symbolic file has no artificial final false cell. Increment appends a
value-one spare; positive decrement retains the suffix and contributes one
extra cell to the header distance. Branch validity explicitly requires a
nonempty spare suffix, which ensures at least ten physical blocks.

These are conditional framing and register-update adapters. No site is
asserted to pass, no decoder coverage is assumed, and no bootstrap or
consistency theorem is claimed here.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation

open RegisterPath FiniteZipper Permutation252Frame SymbolicPrefix250

theorem registerBits_eq (vs : List Nat) :
    RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits vs = Permutation252Frame.registerBits vs := by
  induction vs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v vs ih =>
    change false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits vs) =
      false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ Permutation252Frame.registerBits vs)
    rw [ih]

theorem flat_map_bit (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool) :
    flat n vs (P.map Segment.bit) = P := by
  induction P with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b P ih => simpa only [List.map_cons, flat_cons, segmentBits,
      List.singleton_append] using congrArg (List.cons b) ih

theorem start_concrete (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (Q : List Bool) (h : Int) :
    concrete n vs (SitePrefix250.start Q) h =
      zAtS (some SitePrefix250.dispatch) h [true]
        (Q ++ List.replicate (n + (40 - Q.length)) false ++ [true] ++
          Permutation252Frame.registerBits vs) := by
  simp only [concrete, SitePrefix250.start, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  rw [flat_append, flat_map_bit]
  simp [SitePrefix250.minDistance, flat, segmentBits, boxBits, registerBits_eq,
    zAtS, List.append_assoc]

private theorem strip_padding {binary : Config 250} (q : Option (Fin 250))
    (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) (leftPadding rightPadding : Nat)
    (hz : ZipRep binary (zAtS q h (l ++ List.replicate leftPadding false)
      (r ++ List.replicate rightPadding false))) :
    ZipRep binary (zAtS q h l r) := by
  apply zipRep_at_congr q h _ _ _ _ _ _ hz
  · intro i
    exact getD_append_padding l leftPadding i
  · intro i
    exact getD_append_padding r rightPadding i

/-- The stored path may be shorter than the consumed prefix. The missing
bits are taken from its existing zero gap, preserving the complete tape. -/
theorem source_represents (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 250)
    (gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat) (Q : List Bool)
    (hf : DispatchFrame SitePrefix250.dispatch binary logical gap spares)
    (hq : Q = consume logical.path Q.length)
    (hz : ∀ b ∈ logical.path.drop Q.length, b = false)
    (hd : Q.length ≤ 40) :
    Represents (logical.path.length + gap - 40)
      (vregs logical.registers ++ spares) (SitePrefix250.start Q) binary := by
  rcases hf with ⟨hbudget, htail, leftPadding, rightPadding, hf⟩
  have hpc : logical.path ++ List.replicate gap false =
      Q ++ List.replicate ((logical.path.length + gap - 40) +
        (40 - Q.length)) false := by
    have he := RegisterPathClean.gap_consume logical.path gap Q.length (by omega) hz
    rw [← hq] at he
    rw [he]
    congr 2
    omega
  refine ⟨binary.head, ?_⟩
  rw [start_concrete]
  apply strip_padding _ _ [true]
    (Q ++ List.replicate ((logical.path.length + gap - 40) +
      (40 - Q.length)) false ++ [true] ++
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs logical.registers ++ spares))
    leftPadding rightPadding
  simpa only [dispatchZip, hpc, zAtS, List.singleton_append,
    List.append_assoc] using hf

theorem target_concrete (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool)
    (overflow : Bool) (extra : Nat) (x : Box) (h : Int) :
    concrete n vs (SitePrefix250.target P overflow extra x) h =
      zAtS (some SitePrefix250.dispatch) h [true]
        (P ++ List.replicate (n + (40 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length)) false ++
          [true] ++ boxBits x vs) := by
  simp only [concrete, SitePrefix250.target, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  rw [flat_append, flat_map_bit]
  simp [SitePrefix250.minDistance, flat, segmentBits, zAtS, List.append_assoc]

/-- Rebase a checked symbolic target at the updated logical register file.
The box equality states its entire physical file, including the spare tail. -/
theorem target_frame (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool)
    (overflow : Bool) (extra : Nat) (x : Box) (R' : Registers) (spares' : List Nat)
    (binary : Config 250)
    (hlen : P.length ≤ 40 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra)
    (htail : LogicalTailZero R')
    (hbox : boxBits x vs =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs R' ++ spares'))
    (hr : Represents n vs (SitePrefix250.target P overflow extra x) binary) :
    DispatchFrame SitePrefix250.dispatch binary ⟨P, R'⟩
      (n + (40 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length)) spares' := by
  obtain ⟨h, hr⟩ := hr
  rw [target_concrete, hbox] at hr
  have hh : binary.head = h := hr.2.1
  refine ⟨by dsimp; omega, htail, 0, 0, ?_⟩
  simpa only [dispatchZip, zAtS, hh, List.replicate_zero,
    List.append_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] using hr

theorem incr_eq_write (vs : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < vs.length) :
    incr r vs = writeRegisters vs r (vs.getD r 0 + 1) := by
  induction r generalizing vs with
  | zero => cases vs <;> simp_all [incr, writeRegisters]
  | succ r ih =>
    cases vs with
    | nil => simp at hr
    | cons v vs =>
      change v :: incr r vs = v :: writeRegisters vs r (vs.getD r 0 + 1)
      rw [ih vs (by simpa using hr)]

theorem decr_eq_write (vs : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < vs.length) :
    decr r vs = writeRegisters vs r ((vs.getD r 0).pred) := by
  induction r generalizing vs with
  | zero => cases vs <;> simp_all [decr, writeRegisters]
  | succ r ih =>
    cases vs with
    | nil => simp at hr
    | cons v vs =>
      change v :: decr r vs = v :: writeRegisters vs r ((vs.getD r 0).pred)
      rw [ih vs (by simpa using hr)]

theorem unchanged_rebase (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) :
    boxBits (.plain .unchanged) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs R ++ spares) := by
  simp only [boxBits, registerBits_eq]

theorem nth_vregs_append_getD (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    (vregs R ++ spares).getD (physOf r) 0 = R r := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  exact nth_vregs_append R spares r hr

theorem increment_rebase (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    boxBits (.plain (.increment (SitePrefix250.physical r hr))) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs (update R r (R r + 1)) ++ (spares ++ [1])) := by
  have hp := physOf_lt (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin 9)
  change physOf r < 9 at hp
  change RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits (incr (physOf r) (vregs R ++ spares) ++ [1]) = _
  rw [incr_eq_write _ _ (by simp only [List.length_append, vregs_length]; omega),
    nth_vregs_append_getD R spares r hr, update_vregs_append R spares r (R r + 1) hr,
    List.append_assoc, registerBits_eq]

theorem decrement_rebase (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    boxBits (.plain (.decrement (SitePrefix250.physical r hr))) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits
        (vregs (update R r (R r - 1)) ++ spares) := by
  have hp := physOf_lt (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin 9)
  change physOf r < 9 at hp
  change RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits (decr (physOf r) (vregs R ++ spares)) = _
  rw [decr_eq_write _ _ (by simp only [List.length_append, vregs_length]; omega),
    nth_vregs_append_getD R spares r hr, update_vregs_append R spares r (R r).pred hr]
  simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, List.append_assoc, registerBits_eq]

theorem valid_none (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (hspares : spares ≠ []) :
    Valid none (vregs R ++ spares) := by
  refine ⟨?_, trivial⟩
  cases spares with
  | nil => exact False.elim (hspares rfl)
  | cons v rest => simp only [List.length_append, vregs_length, List.length_cons]; omega

theorem valid_branch (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (hspares : spares ≠ [])
    (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (zero : Bool) (hz : if zero then R r = 0 else R r ≠ 0) :
    Valid (some (SitePrefix250.physical r hr, zero)) (vregs R ++ spares) := by
  refine ⟨(valid_none R spares hspares).1, ?_⟩
  simpa only [SitePrefix250.physical, nth_vregs_append_getD R spares r hr] using hz

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation

open SetTheory.BusyBeaver SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open RegisterPath FiniteZipper Permutation252Frame SymbolicPrefix250 Prefix250Simulation

#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.registerBits_eq
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.flat_map_bit
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.start_concrete
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.source_represents
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.target_concrete
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.target_frame
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.incr_eq_write
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.decr_eq_write
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.unchanged_rebase
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.nth_vregs_append_getD
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.increment_rebase
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.decrement_rebase
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.valid_none
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.valid_branch

example (vs : List Nat) : RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits vs = registerBits vs :=
  registerBits_eq vs

example (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool) : flat n vs (P.map Segment.bit) = P :=
  flat_map_bit n vs P

example (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (Q : List Bool) (h : Int) :
    concrete n vs (SitePrefix250.start Q) h =
      zAtS (some SitePrefix250.dispatch) h [true]
        (Q ++ List.replicate (n + (40 - Q.length)) false ++ [true] ++ registerBits vs) :=
  start_concrete n vs Q h

example (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 250) (gap : Nat)
    (spares : List Nat) (Q : List Bool)
    (hf : DispatchFrame SitePrefix250.dispatch binary logical gap spares)
    (hq : Q = consume logical.path Q.length)
    (hz : ∀ b ∈ logical.path.drop Q.length, b = false) (hd : Q.length ≤ 40) :
    Represents (logical.path.length + gap - 40) (vregs logical.registers ++ spares)
      (SitePrefix250.start Q) binary := source_represents logical binary gap spares Q hf hq hz hd

example (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool) (overflow : Bool)
    (extra : Nat) (x : Box) (h : Int) :
    concrete n vs (SitePrefix250.target P overflow extra x) h =
      zAtS (some SitePrefix250.dispatch) h [true]
        (P ++ List.replicate (n + (40 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length)) false ++
          [true] ++ boxBits x vs) := target_concrete n vs P overflow extra x h

example (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool) (overflow : Bool)
    (extra : Nat) (x : Box) (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (c : Config 250)
    (hlen : P.length ≤ 40 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra)
    (htail : LogicalTailZero R) (hbox : boxBits x vs = registerBits (vregs R ++ spares))
    (hr : Represents n vs (SitePrefix250.target P overflow extra x) c) :
    DispatchFrame SitePrefix250.dispatch c ⟨P, R⟩
      (n + (40 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length)) spares :=
  target_frame n vs P overflow extra x R spares c hlen htail hbox hr

example (vs : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < vs.length) :
    incr r vs = writeRegisters vs r (vs.getD r 0 + 1) := incr_eq_write vs r hr

example (vs : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < vs.length) :
    decr r vs = writeRegisters vs r ((vs.getD r 0).pred) := decr_eq_write vs r hr

example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) :
    boxBits (.plain .unchanged) (vregs R ++ spares) = registerBits (vregs R ++ spares) :=
  unchanged_rebase R spares

example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    (vregs R ++ spares).getD (physOf r) 0 = R r := nth_vregs_append_getD R spares r hr

example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    boxBits (.plain (.increment (SitePrefix250.physical r hr))) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      registerBits (vregs (update R r (R r + 1)) ++ (spares ++ [1])) :=
  increment_rebase R spares r hr

example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    boxBits (.plain (.decrement (SitePrefix250.physical r hr))) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      registerBits (vregs (update R r (R r - 1)) ++ spares) := decrement_rebase R spares r hr

example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (hne : spares ≠ []) :
    Valid none (vregs R ++ spares) := valid_none R spares hne

example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (hne : spares ≠ [])
    (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) (zero : Bool)
    (hz : if zero then R r = 0 else R r ≠ 0) :
    Valid (some (SitePrefix250.physical r hr, zero)) (vregs R ++ spares) :=
  valid_branch R spares hne r hr zero hz

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded exact250 whole-tape framing proof,21 exact prerequisite providers.
Compiles only Prefix250Simulation and its audit, serially, using checked Site
and exact maintained clean-PC providers. Conditional frame adapters only. Prepare-only performs no
compiler/version query. No dependency rebuild, downloads or enlarged options.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,subprocess,time
MODULE='BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation'
PREFIX='SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Simulation.'
SOURCE_SHA='bd5891cf3feceb737b656aff37c5e7eba07fea2e4c6fa8ede038c673459880f7'
AUDIT_SHA='ff47fbf4312e42bbc48b9d9bd8f3d879a9fa3b12c09ff37e2195612bf3c6a763'
MP_RECORD_SHA='92c2bddc7390806e81b30daa15c2bcfe082dcae6555392a57fe6d1ae987df81b'
EXPECTED={'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterPathClean': ('5169528914a46b43bc8215967e921744c4594384da72991405ed75ac0ad7eb69', '7ee1f503f4aa44a089ddd950cc5fd767d0cff1e9987c898f59ac609e30039eb3'), 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RMEquiv': ('cc696ec1d000e9201506f652987d94ba17661114ba785b8dcb09b4f958a32a57', '85816422a56c65d1ebb9787ba9dc099b2618706781e43f86d65c9fda4fc06905'), 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RMDag': ('1acc3a55d22db81eb03748a7b58d2492d449999516bddae75cd39d886d7099c7', '2d61ba6510d4e61c15b72291cb0dd09ace1d6d720e20967202242e237fc8a2f4')}
PROBES=['registerBits_eq', 'flat_map_bit', 'start_concrete', 'source_represents', 'target_concrete', 'target_frame', 'incr_eq_write', 'decr_eq_write', 'unchanged_rebase', 'nth_vregs_append_getD', 'increment_rebase', 'decrement_rebase', 'valid_none', 'valid_branch']
CALLERS=14
TIMEOUT=120
PARENTS={'site':('ce8af0a401b5db1a39ab19933d9920c44778684a488432d49cab868bf2f5cc6a','BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePrefix250')}
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--repo',type=Path,required=True)
for label in PARENTS:p.add_argument('--'+label+'-evidence',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--source',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--audit',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--prepare-only',action='store_true')
a=p.parse_args()
if not __debug__:p.error('Assertions must remain enabled.')
sha=lambda f:hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
R=a.repo.resolve();W=a.output.resolve()
assert not W.is_relative_to(R) and (not W.exists() or not any(W.iterdir()))
S=a.source.resolve() if a.source else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/frame/Prefix250Simulation.lean')
A=a.audit.resolve() if a.audit else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/frame/Audit.lean')
assert sha(S)==SOURCE_SHA and sha(A)==AUDIT_SHA
MP=R/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-mp254-verification.json'
assert sha(MP)==MP_RECORD_SHA
mp=json.loads(MP.read_text())
C=Path(mp['compiler']['path']).resolve()
assert sha(C)==mp['compiler']['sha256']
version=mp['compiler']['version'];toolroot=C.parent.parent/'lib/lean'
def imports(path):
 return re.findall(r'^import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*$',Path(path).read_text(),re.M)
def passed(d):
 assert d['status']=='PASS' and d['only_standard_axioms']
 assert d['all_input_provider_postchecks'] and d['all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit']
 assert len(d['commands'])==2 and [q['label'] for q in d['commands']]==['source','audit']
 assert all(q['exit_code']==0 for q in d['commands'])
 assert d['compiler']['sha256']==sha(C) and d['compiler']['version']==version
passed(mp)
assert imports(S)==['BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterPathClean','BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePrefix250']
assert imports(A)==[MODULE]
assert re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)$',A.read_text(),re.M)==[PREFIX+n for n in PROBES]
assert len(re.findall(r'^example\b',A.read_text(),re.M))==CALLERS
for f in (S,A):
 assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide)\b',f.read_text())
 assert not re.search(r'set_option\s+(maxHeartbeats|maxRecDepth)',f.read_text())
selected={};evidence={str(MP):sha(MP)};parent_snapshots=[];parent_summaries=[]
def add_provider(q,e):
 m=q['module'];s=Path(q['source']).resolve();o=Path(q['object']).resolve()
 assert sha(s)==q['source_sha256'] and sha(o)==q['object_sha256']
 row=dict(module=m,source=str(s),source_sha256=sha(s),object=str(o),object_sha256=sha(o),evidence=str(e))
 if m in selected:
  assert (selected[m]['source_sha256'],selected[m]['object_sha256'])==(row['source_sha256'],row['object_sha256'])
 else:selected[m]=row
pool={q['module']:q for q in mp['reused_modules']}
for m,(ss,oo) in EXPECTED.items():
 q=pool[m];s=R/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean'/Path(m.replace('.','/')).with_suffix('.lean')
 assert sha(s)==ss==q['source_sha256'] and q['object_sha256']==oo
 add_provider(dict(q,source=str(s)),MP)
for label,(pin,module) in PARENTS.items():
 E=getattr(a,label+'_evidence').resolve();assert sha(E)==pin
 parent=json.loads(E.read_text());passed(parent);evidence[str(E)]=pin
 for q in parent['reused_modules']:add_provider(q,E)
 fresh=[q for q in parent['fresh_modules'] if q['module']==module];assert len(fresh)==1
 q=fresh[0];s=Path(parent['source']['path']).resolve();snap=Path(parent['source']['snapshot']).resolve()
 assert q['source_sha256']==parent['source']['sha256']==sha(s)==sha(snap)
 assert sha(q['path'])==q['sha256']
 add_provider(dict(module=module,source=str(s),source_sha256=sha(s),object=q['path'],object_sha256=q['sha256']),E)
 parent_snapshots.append(snap)
 recorded=parent.get('source_object_recorded_before_audit',False)
 assert recorded and parent['source_pass_object']==q
 parent_summaries.append(dict(label=label,evidence=str(E),module=module,
  source_object_recorded_before_audit=recorded,source_sha256=sha(s),object_sha256=q['sha256']))
 for ref in parent.get('provider_evidence',parent.get('parent_evidence',[])):
  f=Path(ref['path']).resolve();assert sha(f)==ref['sha256']
  passed(json.loads(f.read_text()));evidence[str(f)]=ref['sha256']
